title: Rename concept tagging related_to to tagged_with, with a migration
description: Ryan 2026-11-09: one predicate, one meaning. Story and Reference to concept tagging becomes tagged_with (mentions stays for extracted text; related_to stays generic and Reference to Reference). New writers write tagged_with; readers accept both during the transition; a migration (dry-run by default, IAM lane) writes tagged_with rows for legacy current related_to concept edges and retires the old ones; the audit reports legacy rows. Readers to update: about 14 Python modules and 8 TS files mention related_to. Ask ChatGPT to pause new concept batches until the commands land.
